verdict.rationale: Modal's own marketing documents bulk parallel work: fanning out across thousands of GPUs, async batch processing, and creating over a million Sandboxes in under a minute. These are first-party capabilities for operating on many items at once, but the evidence is homepage-level claims with no API reference describing how bulk operations are invoked. Missing for 10: documented bulk/map API semantics (e.g. per-item inputs, batching limits, error handling), CLI or agent-facing bulk operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Fan out over thousands of GPUs, fully parallel, no job orchestration to manage.
Spawn async batch processing and long-running work in the background.
Create over a million Sandboxes in under a minute, and run up to 1M concurrently.
